name: GitHub Issue Authoring
purpose: Author structured, actionable, evidence-linked GitHub issues with objective acceptance criteria.
inputs: Bug or feature context and affected repository area
Minimal reproduction, environment fingerprint, and expected behavior
Labels, priority, roadmap Goal, and related issues
outputs: Actionable issue body with reproduction and acceptance criteria
Priority, labels, dependencies, and sanitized evidence
Validation record confirming the issue is ready for triage
stop_conditions: The issue has a reproducible problem, measurable criteria, safe evidence, and a routed owner
